recipe.title: Barebells Berry Breakfast To Go
recipe.summary: A no-prep breakfast built from a Barebells protein bar, a Chobani Complete yogurt drink, and fresh strawberries.
recipe.story: There are mornings when cooking is not happening. This is the keep-it-moving breakfast: three things, 40 grams of protein, and no fork required.
recipe.serving_size: 1 Barebells Cookies & Cream Protein Bar | 1 Chobani Complete Mixed Berry Yogurt Drink | 1/2 cup strawberries
ingredients: 1 bottle Chobani Complete Mixed Berry Yogurt Drink
instructions: Wash and dry the strawberries. Place them in a small sealed container.
Refrigerate the yogurt drink until cold.
Grab the protein bar, yogurt drink, and strawberries on the way out.
Keep the yogurt drink and strawberries cold until ready to eat.
freezer_storage: Do not freeze the assembled breakfast, yogurt drink, or protein bar.
Strawberries may be washed, dried thoroughly, and frozen in a quart-size freezer bag for smoothies, but thawed berries will not have the same grab-and-go texture.
reheating_instructions: No reheating is needed. Serve the yogurt drink and strawberries cold.
tips: Store the protein bars beside your keys and the yogurt drinks at eye level in the refrigerator.
Use an insulated lunch bag with an ice pack when a refrigerator is not available.
